title: Lung Cancer and Sleep Apnea – Trial
summary: Aim of this large-scale prospective cohort study is to elucidate the prognostic and clinical impact, pathophysiological mechanisms, prevalence and symptoms of SDB in patients with lung cancer
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of bronchus and lung

interventions.name:
- Patients with suspected lung cancer who have been referred to our clinic for further inpatient diagnostics
Day 1:
- Assessment of baseline data
- Evaluation of inclusion/exclusion criteria
- Written informed consent
- Epwoth Sleepiness Scale (ESS)
- Lung Lancer Subscale (LCS)
- Blood gas an

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• Patients with suspected lung cancer that were referred to our clinic for further in-hospital diagnostic procedures
• Written informed consent
• Age 18-90 years
Exclusion criteria:
• Previously established continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) or non-invasive ventilation (NIV)-Therapy
• Previously established long term oxygen therapy (LTOT)
• Evidence of a severely impaired left-ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF <40%)
• Evidence of a severely impaired renal function (GFR <30ml/min)
• Evidence of prior stroke or severe mental health dysfunction
• Inability to tolerate sleep monitoring
